782ebddfbe68f6ea.description: About Mace Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy services to support projects and individuals. The company's values guide its approach to consulting and define the professionals it seeks to join its team. Role Overview This full-time position is for an Assistant Procurement Manager based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves supporting a major commission delivered under a framework contract, focusing on a complex, multi-asset portfolio with a fixed timeline. The Assistant Procurement Manager will provide procurement and pre-contract support for complex, high-value construction packages, working closely with commercial, delivery, and supply-chain stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Support the planning and delivery of procurement activities for construction and consultancy packages. Assist in the development and implementation of procurement strategies and plans aligned with programme requirements. Coordinate tender activities, including preparing procurement documentation, issuing tenders, managing clarifications, conducting evaluations, and formulating recommendations. Maintain procurement schedules, key milestones, risk registers, and trackers, escalating potential issues as appropriate. Ensure procurement activities comply with agreed governance, processes, and procedures, including commission requirements and Mace supply-chain management processes. Support procurement and commercial teams in identifying opportunities to mitigate risk, improve value, and achieve programme objectives. Company Values Mace operates under core values that guide its operations and team interactions: Safety first - Going home safe and well: Championing a safe, diverse, and inclusive working environment, with an understanding of well-being. Client focus - Deliver on our promise: Taking ownership of the quality of deliverables and strategic outcomes, and building long-term client relationships. Integrity - Always do the right thing: Influencing positive outcomes within the industry while adhering to compliance obligations. Create opportunity - For our people to excel: Fostering a continuous improvement culture to inspire development within teams. Application Information Mace is an inclusive employer and encourages applications from a diverse range of candidates. Applicants who may not meet all stated criteria are still encouraged to apply, as they may be suitable for this or other roles within the organization. The company is also open to discussing part-time, flexible, and hybrid working options where suitable for the role.

783b4c3e0ff30e54.description: About Stranger Soccer Stranger Soccer is an international football platform that simplifies game participation through a mobile application. Players can find and book games, then attend to play. Founded in Singapore, Stranger Soccer operates in over 10 cities globally and has facilitated more than 100,000 games. The company is expanding its operations and is seeking a License Owner / Operator in Riyadh. Role Overview Stranger Soccer is seeking a License Owner / Operator to establish and manage its operations in Riyadh. This full-time position is designed for an entrepreneurial individual who will build and grow a local football community and operation under the Stranger Soccer brand. The role involves local ownership and growth, supported by the company's established technology and global expertise from its Singapore headquarters. Candidates should have over 10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Growing the local player community in Riyadh. Securing football venues and establishing local partnerships. Recruiting and managing Official Hosts for games. Leading marketing and community-building initiatives. Ensuring consistent delivery of high-quality game experiences. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be an entrepreneurial self-starter with a strong passion for football and a drive to make a local impact. This role requires an individual capable of building relationships and fostering community growth. Qualifications and Requirements Over 10 years of relevant professional experience. Demonstrated enthusiasm for football. Strong local insight into the Riyadh community. Proven ability to take ownership and drive initiatives. Experience in leadership and community building. Application Process This is an opportunity to build and manage a local football operation as part of an established international brand. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

783fe470c0f6db91.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة زوايا الجزيرة الخضراء للمقاولات عن مصمم أثاث للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، عسير. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ابتكار تصميمات جديدة للمنتجات الخشبية وملحقاتها، مع تحديد المواصفات الفنية اللازمة للإنتاج. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية رسم نماذج أولية وتفصيلية لمنتجات الأثاث واكسسواراتها لتطوير تصميمات جديدة. التشاور مع فرق المبيعات والإدارة والعملاء لمناقشة التصميمات المقترحة والتحسينات المطلوبة. إنتاج نماذج أولية، وتقييم المواصفات وأشكال المنتج وأساليب الإنتاج، وتكرار التصميم لضمان أفضل جودة للمنتج النهائي. فحص المنتجات بعد عملية الإنتاج للتأكد من مطابقتها للتصميم والمواصفات المحددة. مباشرة أعمال الفنيين والمقاولين والموردين، وإبلاغ فريق الإنتاج بأي اختلافات في العقود. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال تصميم الأثاث أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على ابتكار تصميمات جديدة للمنتجات الخشبية وملحقاتها. معرفة بتجهيز المواصفات الفنية، بما في ذلك المواد الخام والأبعاد ومتطلبات الإنتاج. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة أبها بمنطقة عسير. سيعمل المصمم ضمن فريق متخصص في مؤسسة زوايا الجزيرة الخضراء للمقاولات، حيث يساهم في تطوير منتجات الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

786c04269ba229ae.description: About the Role WSP Middle East is seeking an experienced Quality Inspector to join our project supervision team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves monitoring construction activities to ensure compliance with project specifications, quality requirements, and applicable standards. The ideal candidate will have 710 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Conduct regular site inspections to verify compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards. Inspect construction materials, workmanship, and completed works against approved requirements. Review Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), method statements, material approvals, and relevant QA/QC documentation. Witness inspections, testing activities, and material sampling as required. Raise and follow up on Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and site observations. Verify corrective and preventive actions and ensure timely close-out of quality issues. Monitor contractors’ compliance with approved QA/QC procedures and project Quality Plans. Coordinate with engineers, contractors, laboratories, and other project stakeholders regarding quality matters. Maintain accurate inspection records, checklists, quality reports, and supporting documentation. Support audits and ensure proper implementation of project quality procedures. Identify recurring quality issues and report areas requiring corrective action. Ensure works comply with relevant contractual, regulatory, and project-specific requirements. Required Qualifications and Experience 7-10 years of strong site-based inspection and construction supervision experience. Good understanding of QA/QC procedures, ITPs, NCRs, method statements, material inspections, and quality documentation. Familiarity with ISO 9001 Quality Management System principles and applicable construction standards. Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documentation. Skills and Attributes Strong reporting, documentation, coordination, and communication skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, where the Quality Inspector will be an integral part of the project supervision team, ensuring adherence to quality standards across construction activities.

787ed6b8d32683bc.description: About the Role Saudia Dairy & Foodstuff Company (SADAFCO) is seeking a Team Leader Packaging to join their team in Jeddah. This full-time role involves leading and supporting the packaging team to ensure optimal utilization of resources and equipment, aiming for efficient and uninterrupted production of high-quality products. The Team Leader will uphold company quality, safety, and environmental frameworks while fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the team. Key Responsibilities Strictly follow and implement all packaging work instructions, SOPs, OPLs, and procedures in accordance with SADAFCO operational and food safety standards. Develop action plans to enhance efficiencies, improve quality, and minimize wastage. Ensure process equipment is maintained in basic operational condition. Verify that all daily, weekly, and monthly services are completed without compromising quality. Ensure all safety packaging operating practices, policies, and procedures are in place and adhered to. Personally demonstrate correct safety behaviors and conduct accident and Near Miss investigations. Ensure areas achieve and maintain required GMP and Hygiene standards. Support a culture that enhances behavioral awareness to reduce accidents and near misses. Team Leadership and Management Manage and motivate the Packaging Team by setting and monitoring targets. Provide first-line management through coaching, regular appraisals, mentoring, training, and leadership-by-example, including direct responsibility for a named group of staff. Ensure the Time and Attendance system is updated accurately and timely. Manage holiday and days off to ensure department coverage without additional business cost. Manage personnel according to agreed company policies and procedures, including completing return-to-work interviews and documenting absence-related discussions. Ensure adherence to all company discipline procedures and document related discussions. Identify training needs for the team and self, promoting personal ownership of training schedules and delivery. Audit, monitor, and follow the SADAFCO Operating System (SOS), participating in continuous improvement and lean activities. Operational and Organizational Skills Ensure efficient operation and control of all resources within the assigned area. Foster a positive working environment by regularly briefing teams on alignment with team and site objectives. Conduct daily "Start of Shift" and "End of Shift" briefings, and monthly "Performance Reviews." Efficiently utilize team labor resources. Attend daily production/planning meetings. Control rework, wastage, and overtime within targeted KPIs. Identify personal training needs and agree on a time plan with the manager for achievement. Communication and Collaboration Liaise daily/hourly with colleagues within and across functions regarding planning and production matters. Meet daily, weekly, and monthly with the Production Manager to review progress against KPIs and improvement project processes. Work closely with support functions (ES, Quality, Technical & Warehouse) to identify and communicate required resources and resolve outstanding issues. Communicate daily with engineering to ensure planned maintenance, engineering, and production priorities are considered. Conduct daily "End of Shift" and "Start of Shift" briefings with the team. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience is required for this role.

78d363434319c16a.description: About the Role Al-Ayuni Investment and Contracting Company is seeking a Project Control Manager for Industrial & Infrastructure Projects. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves overseeing project controls to ensure large-scale industrial and infrastructure projects are completed on time, within budget, and in compliance with safety and quality standards. The manager will be responsible for managing cost, schedule, risk, and performance reports, while coordinating with engineering, procurement, and construction teams. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) schedules, including baselines and updates, using Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project, ensuring alignment with project phases. Apply the critical path method (CPM) scheduling to large-scale industrial and civil projects. Prepare detailed cost estimates for industrial (*, plant expansions) and infrastructure (*, highways, pipelines) projects. Track actual versus budgeted costs, identify variances, and propose corrective actions. Conduct risk assessments for industrial (*, safety hazards, supply chain delays) and infrastructure (*, environmental permits, land acquisition) risks. Manage change order processes, ensuring accurate documentation and impact assessment. Track progress using Earned Value Management (EVM) and key performance indicators (KPIs) such as CPI and SPI. Prepare weekly and monthly reports for stakeholders, covering cost-to-complete and schedule updates. Manage a team of planners, cost engineers, and estimators. Coordinate with clients, contractors, and government agencies to obtain approvals and ensure compliance. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field. Experience: A minimum of 15 years of experience in project controls for industrial or infrastructure projects is required. Familiarity with EPC contracts, FIDIC, NEC, or lump-sum agreements. Technical Skills Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 Cloud. Experience with Oracle ERP and Power BI. Proficiency in AutoCAD for infrastructure projects. Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables and macros, along with data analysis abilities. Preferred Certifications Project Management Professional (PMP). PMI Scheduling Professional (PMI-SP). AACE certifications (CCP, PSP). PRINCE2. Soft Skills Strong leadership, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work effectively under pressure in fast-paced construction environments.

78dc44495a496225.description: About the Role Abbott is seeking an E-Commerce & Omni-Channel Development Lead to join its Abbott Nutrition International (ANI) team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for driving the growth of Abbott Nutrition's digital commerce business by developing and executing e-commerce and omni-channel strategies across various digital touchpoints. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Role Purpose and Context The E-Commerce & Omni-Channel Development Lead will accelerate sustainable growth for Abbott's Nutrition portfolio. This involves enhancing digital shelf excellence, improving online shopper engagement, optimizing customer journeys, and creating seamless omni-channel experiences. The role supports both healthcare professional recommendations and consumer purchasing behavior, working closely with Sales, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Trade Marketing, Supply Chain, and Digital teams to ensure effective brand representation and compliance with regulations. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute Abbott Nutrition's e-commerce and omni-channel growth strategy to meet business objectives. Achieve annual sales, market share, and profitability targets across digital channels. Identify growth opportunities across pure-play e-commerce, pharmacy e-commerce, marketplaces, quick commerce, and omni-retail customers. Build joint business plans with key e-commerce partners to accelerate category and brand growth. Lead the development of seamless consumer and shopper experiences across online and offline channels. Drive omni-channel initiatives that connect healthcare professional engagement, retail activation, pharmacy recommendations, and digital conversion. Ensure best-in-class product content across all digital platforms and improve product discoverability through search optimization and digital merchandising. Monitor digital shelf KPIs including availability, content compliance, search rankings, ratings & reviews, and share of search. Collaborate with Marketing and Trade Marketing teams to develop digital-first activation plans and drive online campaigns. Monitor and analyze business performance across digital channels, developing dashboards for sales, market share, traffic, conversion, and ROI. Partner with Supply Chain & Distributors to ensure product availability and work with Medical Affairs and Regulatory teams for content compliance. Performance Indicators Key performance indicators for this role include: Financial: E-commerce Net Sales Growth, Market Share Growth, Gross Profit Contribution, Revenue Delivery vs Plan. Commercial Excellence: Digital Shelf Compliance, Share of Search, Product Availability (OSA), Online Assortment Coverage. Consumer Metrics: Conversion Rate, Average Order Value, Repeat Purchase Rate, Customer Acquisition & Retention. Execution Metrics: Joint Business Plan Delivery, Promotional ROI, Customer Satisfaction, Omni-Channel Program Adoption. Company Overview Abbott's nutrition business develops science-based nutrition products for individuals of all ages. These products support growth in babies and children, and maintain strength and activity in adults. Leading brands include Similac®, PediaSure®, Pedialyte®, Ensure®, Glucerna®, and ZonePerfect®.

78e8f34a741dec17.description: About the Role Med City Pharma is seeking a motivated and results-driven Key Account Specialist to join its team in the pharmaceutical sector. This full-time position is based in Makkah, with responsibilities covering both Jeddah and Makkah. The specialist will manage assigned key accounts, strengthen customer relationships, and drive product sales and availability. Role Overview The Key Account Specialist serves as the primary point of contact for key accounts, focusing on driving direct-purchase orders and ensuring continuous product availability. This involves strategic engagement with healthcare accounts, monitoring stock levels, and promoting pharmaceutical products to various stakeholders within the healthcare system. Key Responsibilities Manage assigned key accounts, acting as the primary point of contact to drive direct-purchase (ad-hoc) orders through regular customer visits and follow-ups. Drive product enlistment by preparing and submitting formulary and listing requests, and following up on approvals with Pharmacy & Therapeutics (P&T) Committees and purchasing departments. Monitor stock levels and product consumption across assigned accounts to prevent shortages and overstocking, while ensuring effective order planning. Promote existing and new products to purchasers, pharmacists, and Healthcare Professionals (HCPs), and execute promotional activities to maximize product awareness and sales. Prepare and submit accurate and timely reports covering sales performance, stock levels, consumption, product enlistment status, and account activities. Qualifications and Requirements Minimum of 3 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry. Previous experience in Key Account Management or pharmaceutical sales is preferred. Good understanding of hospital accounts, pharmacy chains, product enlistment, and purchasing processes. Required Skills Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills. Good analytical, reporting, and organizational skills. Self-motivated, proactive, and target-oriented with the ability to achieve sales objectives. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

78f16c565e4e9446.description: About Plaza Premium Group Plaza Premium Group is a global company specializing in airport hospitality, operating in over 200 locations across more than 60 international airports. Established in Hong Kong in 1998, the group provides airport lounges, terminal hotels, meet & greet services, and dining concepts. In addition to its own brands, Plaza Premium Group offers hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporations worldwide, including Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, and Lufthansa. The Role of HR and Admin Executive Plaza Premium Group is seeking a Human Resources and Admin Executive to join its team in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting HR and administrative functions, ensuring smooth office operations, and contributing to team engagement. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Manage the recruitment and selection process, including onboarding and offboarding procedures. Support performance management activities, from staff confirmation to annual performance reviews and employment termination. Assist with staff engagement initiatives and social media efforts to promote employer branding and employee involvement. Ensure compliance with all relevant HR laws and regulations. Provide essential administrative support to the team and operations. Support government relationship management with key stakeholders. Candidate Profile The successful candidate will be a dynamic individual with a passion for human resources and team engagement. This role requires an individual who can listen, act efficiently, think innovatively, and communicate ideas effectively. A commitment to customer service and treating every person with kindness is essential. Required Experience 2-5 years of experience in Human Resources and Administration. Work Environment As part of Plaza Premium Group, you will work within a global company that values diverse backgrounds and perspectives. The role offers an opportunity to collaborate with colleagues from various parts of the world, contributing to services and facilities across international airports.

78203b1b8cdafca8.description: About the Role CEER is seeking an Assistant Manager, Customer Care Charging to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves managing and coordinating the end-to-end home charging operations with a focus on customer satisfaction. The role requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose The Assistant Manager will oversee the entire home charging process, from initial charging requests or new car sales triggers through site assessment, installation, commissioning, invoicing, and warranty support. This includes governing third-party installation partners, coordinating charger availability with the Parts department, and facilitating customer activities through HQ and Retail Service Centers. The role ensures compliance with CEER’s quality, service, commercial, and warranty standards, as well as invoicing procedures. Key Responsibilities Lead the operational delivery of CEER’s home charging installation services across KSA. Ensure effective integration between HQ, Retail Service Centers, Parts, Customer Experience, and third-party installation partners. Support the scalability and continuous improvement of the home charging operating model, including processes, workflows, and procedures based on real experience findings. Manage the operational relationship with appointed third-party home charging installation partners, monitoring supplier performance and compliance with contractual obligations, installation standards, safety requirements, and agreed service levels. Track installation capacity, scheduling, completion, and customer satisfaction, and manage escalated issue resolution in cooperation with CRM. Manage the complete charging customer journey, including coordinating installation-related requests, arranging site visits for technical assessments, monitoring quotations, and ensuring compliance with contracted pricing mechanisms and labor rates. Facilitate customer complaints and escalations, ensuring accurate and timely customer communication throughout the installation lifecycle. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience is required for this position. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on operational delivery and customer care within the home charging sector. Application Information Salary details for this role are not disclosed.

783ee9f022b71606.description: About the Role Marsh, a global leader in insurance brokerage and risk advisory, is seeking a Business Development Executive to join its Sales Division in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on identifying and acquiring new clients through partnership schemes, contributing to business growth within the region. Key Responsibilities Identify and build a strong pipeline of new business opportunities within the country through proactive outreach, networking, and referrals via partnerships. Represent Marsh at industry conferences and events to expand the professional network. Conduct thorough research and plan customer acquisition strategies. Develop and maintain strong relationships with potential and existing clients to increase penetration across multiple solutions. Create, negotiate, and close sales proposals covering the full suite of products. Assist in preparing due diligence reports and presentations in response to client requests. Deliver presentations and provide guidance to senior-level stakeholders. Consistently strive to exceed sales performance targets. Maintain accurate client interaction records in the CRM system. Stay informed on the latest trends in Medical and Non-Medical Insurance Products. Professional Development and Support The role offers opportunities for professional experience within a global company. Collaboration with in-country specialists is expected to drive business growth. Ongoing support, coaching, and development are provided to assist in performance excellence. Work Environment and Compensation Marsh operates a hybrid working model, offering flexibility and a supportive work environment. Colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week for in-person collaboration. The compensation package includes a competitive salary, commission, and benefits. Commitment to Inclusion Marsh is committed to providing an inclusive work environment. The company aims to attract and retain qualified individuals and values colleagues of all backgrounds, without regard to age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

78b0e445762870ea.description: About the Role Egis is seeking a Design Manager PMC (Aviation) to lead the PMC design review team for aviation projects in Jeddah and Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves ensuring that contractor designs are reviewed, coordinated, and approved in a timely manner, adhering to client requirements, relevant codes, and operational needs. The position requires a minimum of 10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Lead and coordinate the PMC design team, including civil, architectural, mechanical, electrical, and ICT design leads, allocating design review work across various packages. Manage the design review process for concept, schematic, and detailed design submittals, issuing consolidated review comments within contractual periods. Verify design compliance with employer requirements, Saudi Building Code, GACA and aviation regulations, and international standards. Review and monitor contractor design programmes, deliverables lists, and design manpower, reporting delays and risks to the Project Director and Project Manager. Coordinate design interfaces between disciplines, with contractor design teams, airport operators, and other stakeholders, resolving clashes and design conflicts. Review value engineering proposals, design changes, and variations for technical, cost, and programme impact, collaborating with the Cost Manager and Risk & Planning Manager. Provide design input to site supervision regarding constructability, RFIs, material approvals, and as-built information. Lead design review meetings and workshops, track comment resolution to closure, and prepare design status reports for weekly and monthly reports. Supervise and develop design leads, and manage the utilization of specialist design services. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 10 years of experience in design management, particularly within a Project Management Consultancy (PMC) framework. Demonstrated experience in aviation projects is essential. Strong understanding of design review processes, contractual obligations, and regulatory compliance. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role requires on-site presence to effectively lead the design review team and coordinate with various stakeholders.

7841841cf925a778.job_title: Director Delivery Programs - Dammam Entertainment Complex
7841841cf925a778.description: Job Purpose Oversee the execution of the delivery program under remit across SEVEN's assets to convert capital plans into commissioned, operationally-ready outcomes. Standardize program-level execution discipline and FIDIC contracting cadence within the cluster framework to strengthen accountability, quality, and cost certainty. Cultivate the program team that sustains disciplined, on-time, on-budget delivery. Accountabilities Oversee the execution of the delivery program under remit across SEVEN's assets to align program outcomes with the cluster agenda and the division's capital plan. Evaluate PMC and cost-consultant long-list and short-list submissions within the program's tender process to secure qualified delivery partners under the FIDIC framework. Align delivery workstreams with the PMO, Technical Office, and Commercial Planning & Project Control to harmonize design and cost-schedule-quality controls across the delivery program under remit. Ensure PMC and contractor adherence to FIDIC contracting terms and QHSES quality standards across the delivery program under remit to protect SEVEN's development integrity. Optimize schedule, budget, quality, and contractual performance across the delivery program under remit to protect cost certainty and delivery confidence. Review testing, commissioning, and handover readiness across the delivery program under remit to ensure a seamless transition to Operations and Asset Management. Standardize program reporting, progress reviews, and escalation pathways across the delivery program under remit to enable timely intervention on variances and risks. Recommend corrective actions, value-engineering opportunities, and risk-mitigation measures across the delivery program under remit to inform investment decisions and protect program economics. Govern change control, risk management, and early-warning reporting across the delivery program under remit to protect scope, budget, and schedule. Engage government authorities, operators, and Operations early in design and delivery to secure approvals and operational readiness across the delivery program under remit Managerial Accountabilities Strategy: Set delivery programs departmental plans, standards, and improvement priorities to support portfolio delivery and divisional objectives. Stakeholders: Align cross-functional stakeholders, consultants, contractors, and partners to resolve priorities, risks, and dependencies affecting delivery programs outcomes. Budget: Manage delivery programs budgets, resourcing, and consultant capacity to deliver approved outcomes within control limits. Governance: Enforce policies, standards, reporting routines, and risk controls to maintain compliant, auditable delivery programs controls. People: Develop team capability, succession depth, and accountable ways of working to sustain reliable delivery programs performance. Minimum Qualifications • Minimum: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management, or related field; Master's Degree preferred • Preferred Field: Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management, or related field Professional Certifications • PMP or equivalent project management certification — preferred • FIDIC contract management certification — preferred • RICS, PE, AACE, or similar professional certification — preferred Required Experience • Minimum Years of Relevant Experience: 15-20 years • Industry Experience (Preferred): Experience leading large-scale giga-projects, real estate developments, hospitality and/or themed entertainment destinations, water parks or infrastructure delivery programs • Minimum Supervisory Experience: 8 years including at least 5 years in relevant large scale developments including themed entertainment and hospitality components

788030284586543d.description: About the Role Delta Hotels and Resorts® is seeking an Event Executive to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is based in either Jeddah or Makkah and is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. The Event Executive will play a key role in supporting sales and marketing activities, ensuring smooth operations, and maintaining high standards of guest service. Key Responsibilities Regularly update information boards to inform employees about important events. Provide assistance and guidance to employees regarding job duties, such as improving package sales numbers. Assign lead calls or emails to Sales Executives based on a rotational system. Create spreadsheets to organize information related to Sales and Marketing activities, including mailing lists and tour schedules. Enter, retrieve, reconcile, and verify information within sales process software. Contact appropriate individuals or departments to resolve guest calls, requests, or problems. Promote awareness of the brand image both internally and externally. Utilize sales techniques to maximize revenue while maintaining guest loyalty to Marriott, including up-selling. Encourage guests or callers to purchase or schedule preview package sales/tours and answer questions about property facilities and services. Assist management with hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees. Serve as a role model and the first point of contact for the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to the manager. Adhere to all company policies and procedures, ensuring a clean and professional uniform and personal appearance, and protecting company assets. Anticipate and address guests’ service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and express genuine appreciation to guests. Communicate professionally and clearly, prepare and review written documents accurately, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards, and identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to enhance organizational quality. Read and visually verify information in various formats. Perform physical tasks such as moving, lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, and placing objects weighing up to 10 pounds without assistance. Execute other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors. Qualifications and Requirements Education: High school diploma or GED equivalent. Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience is preferred. Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience is required for this role. License or Certification: None specified. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with work locations potentially including Jeddah. The role involves working within a dynamic hospitality environment, requiring interaction with employees and guests to ensure operational efficiency and high service standards.

78a07f590a2185b7.description: Position Summary Emerson is seeking a Senior Sales Manager to drive the growth of Instrumented Control and Safety Systems (ICSS) and advance digitalization solutions across assigned industry accounts in the Western Region of Saudi Arabia and Bahrain. This full-time role involves developing and executing strategic growth plans in collaboration with regional project pursuit teams, strategic account managers, and global business leaders. The position is based in the Eastern Region of Saudi Arabia, covering cities such as Dammam, Al Khobar, Dhahran, Al Jubail, Al-Ahsa, Al Qatif, Ras Tannurah, Buqayq, and Al Khafji. A minimum of 10 years of experience is required for this role. Role Context and Objectives This role is critical for delivering growth objectives within the Control Systems and Software (CSS) business, focusing on key markets in Saudi Arabia and Bahrain. The Senior Sales Manager will develop strategic account plans and expand Emerson's footprint in ICSS, software, and digital transformation. The successful candidate will contribute to strengthening Emerson's leadership in the automation market and lead customer engagement strategies for Enterprise Operations Platform (EOP) solutions. This position requires strategic thinking, customer focus, commercial acumen, and adaptability within the regional business environment. Key Responsibilities Lead sales and business development initiatives for assigned industry accounts. Achieve or exceed territory financial objectives in support of the CSS Western Region business plan. Drive Emerson's Enterprise Operations Platform (EOP) vision and lead customer engagements related to autonomous operations, data management, enterprise-wide operations, and integration with corporate business systems. Partner with key customer accounts on digital transformation initiatives and collaborate with technology and product teams to develop suitable solutions. Develop and execute sales strategies for project opportunities, maintaining an accurate project pursuit pipeline, forecasts, and monthly business reports. Prepare and present market forecasts, pricing analyses, competitive intelligence, and regional marketing plans. Collaborate with proposal development teams to ensure customer-focused, competitive, and timely proposal submissions. Enhance customer satisfaction by identifying solutions that address business and operational challenges. 78549f038e389676.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مريزيق رافد العنزي للتجارة والمقاولات عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على جميع أنشطة الصيانة، بما في ذلك إعداد الخطط والبرامج، وتوزيع المهام، وتقييم الأداء، وتطوير برامج الصيانة الوقائية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى مشرف الصيانة مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية، وتشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الشامل لعمليات الصيانة. متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة وتقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم بشكل دوري. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها لضمان استمرارية العمل. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ النتائج وتقارير العمل المتعلقة بالصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن تتوفر في المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصيانة أو دور إشرافي مماثل. القدرة على إعداد خطط وبرامج العمل ومتابعة تنفيذها. مهارات ممتازة في توزيع المهام وإدارة فريق العمل. القدرة على تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية وتطوير مهارات الفريق. المهارات والكفاءات يتطلب الدور مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية قوية، بالإضافة إلى القدرة على التخطيط والتنفيذ الفعال لبرامج الصيانة. يجب أن يكون المرشح قادراً على التواصل بوضوح وفعالية مع أعضاء الفريق والإدارة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جازان، ضمن فريق عمل شركة مريزيق رافد العنزي للتجارة والمقاولات. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تساهم في تطوير مهارات الموظفين وتحقيق أهداف الصيانة بكفاءة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

78be93a791d641aa.description: About the Role Abdullah A. Al-Barrak & Son Co. is seeking an Electrical (SMP) professional to join their team in Dhahran, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves maintaining and troubleshooting electrical systems within critical industrial facilities, ensuring safe and reliable operations. Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on electrical systems to ensure safe and reliable operations. Inspect, test, and troubleshoot electrical transformers, switchgear, circuit breakers, and motor control centers (MCC). Review and monitor cost plans, bills of quantities, estimates, tender documentation, contracts, and commercial submissions. Ensure project costs and commercial activities comply with project requirements, contractual obligations, procurement strategies, and industry standards. Monitor contractor performance and assess progress against approved budgets, schedules, and contractual milestones. Review and evaluate contractor valuations, interim payment applications, variations, change requests, claims, and final accounts. Coordinate quantity surveying interfaces with civil, structural, landscape, infrastructure, utility, architectural, MEP, and specialist project disciplines. Conduct regular site visits to verify completed works, quantities, progress measurements, and valuation of construction activities. Monitor project risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impacts on project cost, schedule, and commercial performance. 78ee19a040f43e1f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة دار المعدات الطبية والعلمية عن أخصائي تغذية سريرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم المشورة الغذائية للمرضى وإعداد برامج تغذية مخصصة بناءً على احتياجاتهم الصحية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بالتغذية السريرية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة توصيات الطبيب المعالج لتحديد أنواع الأغذية المناسبة لحالة المريض الصحية وقيمها الغذائية، وتحديد حاجة المريض من السعرات الحرارية. إعداد برامج تغذية فردية للمرضى تتناسب مع حالتهم الصحية. تقييم فعالية البرامج الغذائية المطبقة ومراجعة النتائج المحققة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال التغذية السريرية. إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالتغذية السريرية في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة خلال جميع أعمال التغذية السريرية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التغذية السريرية. القدرة على تحليل الحالات الصحية للمرضى وتحديد احتياجاتهم الغذائية بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل أخصائي التغذية السريرية ضمن فريق متخصص لتقديم أفضل رعاية للمرضى. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تساهم في التطور المهني. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في المدينة المنورة.

782a3dff4efa6676.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث سجل فندق بدر حمود معجل الفرج للضيافة السياحي عن مدير مالي للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. يتولى المدير المالي مسؤولية الإدارة والإشراف على جميع العمليات المالية والمحاسبية للمنشأة، بهدف ضمان سلامة الوضع المالي وتحقيق الكفاءة في استخدام الموارد، بالإضافة إلى تعزيز الربحية والاستدامة المالية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة واسعة في المجال المالي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد الميزانيات والخطط المالية السنوية للمنشأة. الإشراف المباشر على الحسابات والقوائم والتقارير المالية. إدارة التدفقات النقدية والسيولة لضمان الاستقرار المالي. مراقبة الإيرادات والمصروفات والتكاليف بشكل دوري. متابعة التحصيل والمديونيات والالتزامات المالية. ضمان الالتزام الكامل بالأنظمة المالية والضريبية والزكوية المعمول بها. تحليل الأداء المالي وتقديم التوصيات اللازمة للإدارة العليا. تطوير السياسات والإجراءات والرقابة المالية الداخلية. الإشراف على فريق العمل داخل الإدارة المالية وتوجيههم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية لا تقل عن 10 سنوات في مجال الإدارة المالية أو المحاسبة. فهم عميق للمبادئ المحاسبية والمعايير المالية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات المالية وتقديم رؤى استراتيجية. إتقان استخدام البرامج والأنظمة المالية والمحاسبية. بيئة العمل والمزايا يعمل المدير المالي ضمن فريق متخصص في نجران، في بيئة عمل داعمة تهدف إلى تحقيق الأهداف المالية للمنشأة. يتم تقديم راتب شهري يتراوح بين 11,250 ريال سعودي و 15,000 ريال سعودي، حسب الخبرة والمؤهلات. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التزاماً كاملاً بالمهام والمسؤوليات المحددة لضمان سير العمليات المالية بكفاءة وفعالية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لشغل هذا المنصب.

78133ff1b18c241a.description: Who Are We❓ We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarters in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners. The Job in a Nutshell💡 We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to sit between our customers and our product. You will embed with strategic merchants and partners, ship production code that solves their problems, and turn what you learn into reusable platform capabilities. Large chains and integration partners often need more than configuration: custom integrations, data flows and workflows that stretch the product. You own that work end to end, from the first discovery call to production rollout. This is a full-stack, customer facing engineering role. You write real code in our .NET microservices, Kafka-based event backbone and front-end apps, and you are measured on customer outcomes, not tickets closed. What Will You Do❓ Embed with customers Work directly with enterprise merchants, franchise groups and integration partners to understand their operations, systems and pain points. Run technical discovery: map their workflows, data and existing systems (ERP, delivery aggregators, loyalty, payment providers) against Foodics capabilities. Scope solutions, set clear expectations, and own delivery dates with the customer. Build and ship production software Design and build backend services and integrations in .NET (C#) following Clean Architecture and CQRS. Build event-driven flows on Kafka: producers, consumers, retries, dead-letter handling, idempotency and schema evolution. Use Redis for caching, rate limiting and short-lived state, with sound invalidation and TTL strategies. Build or extend front-end experiences (web apps, admin tools, mini-apps) when the solution needs a UI. Ship through CI/CD and own what you ship: observability in Datadog, alerts, runbooks and on-call for your deployments. Turn field work into product Spot patterns across customers and propose platform features instead of one-off forks. Write clear specs and handover docs so core teams can adopt and maintain what you built. Be the voice of the customer in roadmap discussions, backed by data on usage, impact and effort. Build the FDE motion Turn one-off deployments into repeatable playbooks, tooling, SDKs and reference integrations. Help define how FDE engagements are scoped and measured, and share learnings across Product, Engineering, Solutions and Customer Success. What Are We Looking For❓ 6+ years building and running production software, including 3+ years on backend systems at scale. A track record of owning work end to end, from an ambiguous problem to a solution running in production. Experience working directly with customers, partners or business stakeholders and turning their needs into technical plans. Strong C# and .NET (.NET 8+), ASP.NET Core APIs and microservices design; Clean Architecture, CQRS/MediatR and DDD fundamentals. Hands-on Kafka in production: partitioning, consumer groups, delivery semantics, idempotency, retries and DLQs, and the outbox pattern. Redis in production: cache-aside, TTL and invalidation, distributed locks and rate limiting, with awareness of consistency trade-offs. Solid relational modelling and SQL (PostgreSQL or SQL Server), with Dapper or EF Core and query performance tuning. Production front-end experience with a modern framework (Vue/Nuxt, React or Angular) and TypeScript. Integration experience: REST and webhook design, OAuth2/OIDC, API versioning, and third-party systems such as ERP, payments or delivery platforms. Comfort with Docker, Kubernetes basics, CI/CD and observability tools such as Datadog. A product mindset: you start from the customer's outcome, push back when a request is not the real problem, and measure whether what you shipped is used. Clear written and spoken English, and the confidence to present to an engineering team and a restaurant group's executives on the same day. Nice to Have Experience in restaurant tech, retail, POS, payments, loyalty or delivery aggregator integrations. A previous role as a Forward Deployed, Solutions, Integration or Customer Engineer at a product company. Building with LLMs and AI agents in production (prompting, tool use, evaluations), applied to customer workflows. Mobile exposure (Swift/SwiftUI, Kotlin, Flutter or React Native), or experience with super-app and mini-app models. Product analytics and instrumentation (Mixpanel, Snowflake, SQL-based analysis). Arabic, and experience working with customers in Saudi Arabia and the GCC. What We Offer You❗ We believe you will love working at Foodics! We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares. We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment. Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry. We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.

78550f6bfbea4aa8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة عيادات الدكتور مساعد عبدالعزيز الزلال عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، بالمنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى توفير تجربة استقبال ممتازة للزوار والعملاء، وإدارة المكالمات الهاتفية، وتنظيم المواعيد، وضمان سير العمليات الإدارية بسلاسة في بيئة مهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء بترحيب، وتحديد احتياجاتهم، وتزويدهم بالمعلومات اللازمة. إبلاغ الموظفين المعنيين بوجود المراجعين والعملاء وتوجيههم إليهم. التعامل مع المكالمات الهاتفية الواردة، والرد على الاستفسارات، أو تحويل المكالمات إلى الأقسام المختصة. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية لجمع المعلومات المطلوبة أو تنسيق المهام. ترتيب وتنسيق مواعيد المقابلات والاجتماعات. تسجيل بيانات المراجعين والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة لذلك بدقة. الالتزام التام بالسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة والأدلة الإجرائية المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بمهنية ولباقة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

789296d68a1154e1.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع ركن علاجي لطب الاسنان عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقه في حائل. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تشخيص وعلاج أمراض الفم والأسنان، وتقديم رعاية شاملة للمرضى. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحوصات الشاملة للأسنان، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة وتحليلها، وتشخيص الحالات المرضية للفم والأسنان. إعداد خطط العلاج وبرامجها الزمنية بما يتناسب مع حالة كل مريض. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات، ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان. تنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة، وإجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى. وصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة للمرضى. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بطب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال طب وصحة الأسنان. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة شهادة جامعية في طب الأسنان. خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة. إتقان إجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع المرضى والزملاء. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية والأخلاقية. القدرة على استخدام التقنيات والأدوات الحديثة في طب الأسنان. بيئة العمل يعمل طبيب الأسنان العام ضمن مجمع ركن علاجي لطب الاسنان في حائل. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

781787f1298b312f.description: About the Role Najim Systems (أنظمة نجم) is seeking a Cybersecurity Trainee to join its team in Dammam, Eastern Province. This full-time role is designed for individuals studying cybersecurity or recent graduates with 0-1 years of experience who are keen to apply their knowledge in a practical setting. The trainee will work alongside the technical team, supporting daily cybersecurity activities and learning to protect networks, systems, and information under the guidance of experienced team members. Company Overview Najim Systems (أنظمة نجم) is a Saudi technology partner established in 2010, specializing in integrated physical security, autonomous robotics, and AI-driven intelligence. The company supports organizations requiring advanced, reliable security solutions for mission-critical environments. Najim Systems is SAIS-certified, demonstrating its commitment to national standards and regulatory compliance. The team focuses on protecting people, assets, and operations across demanding security settings. Assisting with basic security assessments and authorized vulnerability scans under supervision. Documenting findings and supporting the tracking of corrective actions. Supporting checks on user access, software updates, endpoint protection, and device security settings. Assisting with incident response tasks, including gathering relevant logs and maintaining incident records. Helping maintain security procedures, checklists, and employee awareness materials. 7858af7fc3ed47df.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة واجز للمقاولات عن مدير أشغال ومرافق عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدوادمي، الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق أنشطة إدارة المرافق في المنشأة، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية الحالية والمستقبلية، والتصاميم، والأثاث. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الخطط والسياسات والاستراتيجيات الإدارية العامة لمرافق الشركة، والإشراف على تنفيذها. ضمان الالتزام بقواعد الصحة والسلامة والبيئة ولوائحها، والإشراف على تطبيقها. الإشراف على الأنشطة اليومية للمرافق في المنشأة، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية، والتصاميم، والأثاث. تخطيط الجداول الزمنية لأعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمرافق. الإشراف على أنشطة الصيانة، وتنسيق عمليات التصليح لتقليل مدة التوقف عن العمل. اختيار الموظفين وتدريبهم والإشراف عليهم، ومراقبة أدائهم وسلوكهم مقارنةً بالأهداف المحددة. تخطيط أعمال الإنشاء والملحقات الجديدة، وإعداد العقود المتعلقة بالبناء ومراجعتها والموافقة عليها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في إدارة الأشغال والمرافق العامة. فهم قوي لمبادئ إدارة المرافق والصيانة. القدرة على تخطيط وتنظيم الجداول الزمنية والمهام المتعددة. مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الدوادمي، الرياض، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية في قطاع المقاولات. سيعمل المدير ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تطوير البنية التحتية للمنشآت. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل المنطقة: الرياض المدينة: الدوادمي الراتب: غير معلن التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة واجز للمقاولات.

78fcccfb28223f56.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة مجالات الرياض للمقاولات عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على تطبيق معايير السلامة والصحة المهنية في مواقع العمل، وضمان الامتثال للوائح والتعليمات، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال ضبط الجودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق القوانين واللوائح التنظيمية والتعليمات المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية في الموقع. إجراء عمليات التفتيش الدورية والطارئة في مواقع العمل بشأن السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتسجيل النتائج ومقارنتها بالمعايير المعتمدة. تجهيز معدات وأجهزة قياس العوامل البيئية مثل درجة الحرارة والرطوبة والضجيج والاهتزاز، وتوثيق النتائج ومتابعة معالجة الأخطار. تحضير مستلزمات التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات، وإجراء التحقيقات اللازمة وتوثيق النتائج. إعداد تعليمات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية، وتعليمات العمل الآمن والإخلاء، وتوعية العاملين بها. الإشراف على جميع أعمال المقاول ضمن النطاق التعاقدي فيما يخص متطلبات السلامة وضبط الجودة والامتثال لمتطلبات العمل. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. معرفة قوية بالقوانين واللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على إجراء عمليات التفتيش والتحقيق في الحوادث. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير وتوثيقها. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، وتتطلب العمل في مواقع المقاولات لضمان تطبيق معايير السلامة والجودة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

78eeb890e16a50cd.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع شفاء الشملي الطبي عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقه في منطقة حائل، وتحديداً في مدينتي حائل والشملي. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بتشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان، ووضع الخطط العلاجية، وإجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص الشامل لأسنان المرضى، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة وتحليلها، وتشخيص الحالات المرضية للفم والأسنان، ثم إعداد خطة العلاج والبرنامج الزمني الخاص بها. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات، ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان، وتنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها، ومعالجة التهابات اللثة، وإجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى، ووصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات ممتازة في إجراء المعالجات السنية المختلفة وجراحات الفم الصغرى. بيئة العمل يعمل طبيب الأسنان العام ضمن فريق طبي متخصص في مجمع شفاء الشملي الطبي، ويساهم في تقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى في حائل والشملي. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بجدول العمل المحدد. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور لم يتم الكشف عنه، وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في مجمع شفاء الشملي الطبي.

789d4ed6817f196d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث العالمية للخدمات البيئية عن كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في حفر الباطن، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية إجراء الأبحاث والتحاليل الكيميائية للعناصر والمركبات، بهدف تطوير المنتجات والعمليات والتطبيقات. الدور متاح بنظام الدوام الكامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. الغرض من الوظيفة يهدف هذا الدور إلى دعم جهود الشركة في البحث والتطوير من خلال إجراء التحاليل الكيميائية الدقيقة، وتحسين الأساليب التحليلية، وتنفيذ التجارب المخبرية. يساهم الكيميائي في إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة التي توثق نتائج الأعمال والاختبارات، مما يدعم اتخاذ القرارات المبنية على البيانات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الأبحاث والتجارب والتحاليل الكمية والنوعية للعناصر والمركبات العضوية واللاعضوية لتحديد خواصها الكيميائية وبنيتها وتفاعلاتها. دراسة وتحليل نتائج التحاليل والأبحاث بشكل منهجي ودقيق. تصميم وتطوير وسائل وأساليب وتجهيزات جديدة، وتحسين المعادلات والعمليات والطرق لحل المشكلات الفنية العملية. إجراء الأبحاث على المنتجات الكيميائية المصنعة بهدف تطوير وتحسين الإجراءات والعمليات وجودة المنتجات النهائية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل الحالية ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الكيمياء. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بنتائج الدراسات الفيزيائية وسبل تطويرها. عرض وتوضيح التقارير والنتائج، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الكيمياء أو التحاليل الكيميائية. القدرة على إجراء الأبحاث والتحاليل الكيميائية المعقدة. معرفة قوية بالتحاليل الكمية والنوعية. القدرة على تحسين الطرق التحليلية وتصميم التجارب المخبرية. بيئة العمل يعمل الكيميائي في بيئة مخبرية متخصصة ضمن فريق عمل في حفر الباطن، المنطقة الشرقية. تتطلب الوظيفة الالتزام بالدوام الكامل والعمل المباشر على التجارب والتحاليل. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

78fe9b2aa5428ca4.description: We are seeking an experienced SAP Procurement Solutions Analyst – S/4HANA & Ariba to support and enhance procurement technology solutions across SAP S/4HANA, SAP Ariba, and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) . The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, procurement teams, IT teams, suppliers, and technology partners to analyze business requirements, support solution design, troubleshoot system issues, and drive continuous improvements across SAP procurement platforms. The work location would be at Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia. Responsibilities Support and maintain procurement solutions across SAP S/4HANA, SAP Ariba, and SAP BTP . Support SAP MM / Materials Management processes, including purchasing, purchase orders, goods/services procurement, and related master data. Support end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes and ensure effective integration between procurement systems. Provide functional support for SAP Ariba modules and capabilities, including: Ariba Sourcing Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP) Guided Buying Supplier onboarding Supplier relationship management Procurement and sourcing processes Support supplier lifecycle management , including supplier onboarding, qualification, maintenance, and integration with enterprise systems. Support service procurement processes, including Service Entry Sheets and related purchasing activities. Support procurement processes within SAP S/4HANA and ECC , ensuring alignment with business and operational requirements. Analyze and resolve system issues, incidents, and process-related challenges across SAP procurement platforms. Support integrations between SAP Ariba, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP , and other enterprise applications. Work with technical teams to investigate integration issues, data flows, interfaces, and system defects. Participate in solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support. Prepare and maintain functional specifications, process documentation, test scenarios, and user documentation. Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and coordinate with business users to validate solutions. Identify opportunities to improve procurement processes through automation, system enhancements, and digital procurement capabilities. Collaborate with procurement, finance, supply chain, IT, and other business stakeholders to ensure solutions meet operational requirements. Support system upgrades, enhancements, releases, and continuous improvement initiatives. Monitor procurement system performance and ensure timely resolution of business-critical issues. Strong experience with SAP S/4HANA Procurement and SAP MM . Hands-on experience with SAP Ariba and its procurement and sourcing capabilities. Good understanding of Source-to-Pay (S2P) / Procure-to-Pay (P2P) business processes. Experience with Ariba Sourcing, Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance (SLP), Guided Buying, and supplier onboarding . Strong understanding of purchasing processes, including purchase orders, supplier management, material management, and service procurement . Experience with Service Entry Sheets and service procurement processes. Knowledge of SAP ECC Procurement and integration with S/4HANA environments. Understanding of SAP Ariba integrations with S/4HANA/ECC and other enterprise systems. Exposure to SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and its role in enterprise application integration and digital solutions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technology solutions. Good understanding of procurement and supplier management business processes. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Experience working with cross-functional business and IT teams. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities. Preferred SAP certification in SAP S/4HANA Procurement, SAP MM, or SAP Ariba . Experience with SAP Ariba implementation, rollout, enhancement, or integration projects. Experience working in large-scale enterprise procurement environments. Knowledge of SAP integration technologies and APIs. Experience with process optimization, automation, and digital procurement transformation initiatives.
